# stb_truetype

Unmodified `stb_truetype.h`, version 1.26, pinned to:
https://github.com/nothings/stb/commit/6e9f34d5429cf16790ec43c9bac3f1ee4ad1f760

license is retained verbatim in `LICENSE` and at the end of the header.
